title: donutsmptr baltop
body:
DonutBalTop - Lightweight Balance Leaderboard

A lightweight and efficient balance ranking plugin for Minecraft servers, designed with performance in mind. Features a clean GUI, VAULT integration, player search, and zero impact on server TPS.

Features

Modern GUI
Clean and intuitive chest-style interface with Small Caps font support for a premium look.

VAULT Integration
Fully compatible with all economy plugins that support VAULT, including EssentialsX, CMI, and custom economy solutions.

Player Search
Quickly locate any player's balance and ranking position using the built-in search function without scrolling through pages.

Smart Caching
Implements an intelligent caching system that refreshes every 30 seconds. This approach ensures that the plugin never queries the economy database on every click, resulting in zero TPS impact even on servers with hundreds of players.

Pagination System
Players are listed across multiple pages with intuitive navigation. Each page loads instantly thanks to the optimized cache layer.

Low Memory Footprint
The plugin operates entirely within a minimal memory allocation of approximately 10MB. It does not create unnecessary objects, timers, or background tasks that could affect server performance.

Commands

/baltop - Opens the balance ranking GUI.
/baltop page - Opens a specific page directly.
/baltop search player - Finds and displays a specific player's ranking and balance.
/baltop reload - Reloads the configuration file without restarting the server.

Configuration

All plugin messages, GUI titles, and cache intervals are fully configurable through the config.yml file. Server administrators can customize the plugin to match their server's branding and language requirements.

Compatibility

Minecraft Versions: 1.16.5 and above (Paper, Purpur, and forks)
Java Version: Java 8 or higher
Dependencies: VAULT, any Vault-compatible economy plugin

Performance Notes

This plugin was specifically designed for servers where performance is critical. It does not run any repeating background tasks, does not hook into player movement or combat events, and only executes logic when a player explicitly opens the GUI or runs a command. The cache mechanism ensures that economy data is fetched at controlled intervals rather than on demand.

Support

For issues, suggestions, or inquiries, contact voidwalkerm on Discord.
